description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisitions of the lands in Sooriyapaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding statutory compensation for acquired lands. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition and compensation matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category.
